description: This file defines the NodeId class and related classes in the Thunder::Core namespace, representing network node identifiers with support for various address types, including IPv4, IPv6, domain sockets, netlink, Bluetooth, and packet sockets. It includes methods for constructing, comparing, and querying node addresses, as well as handling platform-specific socket details.

classes.name: NodeId
classes.description: Represents a network node identifier supporting multiple address types and platform-specific socket details.

classes.name: IPNode
classes.description: Derived from NodeId, adds subnet mask support for IP addresses.

methods.name: Extension
methods.description: Returns the extension field of the socket address, such as protocol or type-specific data.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the address type enumeration of the NodeId.

methods.name: PortNumber
methods.description: Gets or sets the port number associated with the NodeId.

methods.name: HostName
methods.description: Retrieves the hostname associated with the NodeId.

methods.name: HostAddress
methods.description: Returns the IP address or hostname as a string.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the NodeId has a valid address type.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the NodeId is empty or uninitialized.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Compares two NodeId objects for equality.
